description:
Requirement: Production contract to produce F-16 Power Supply NSN 6130-01-373-0561WF, 5 Year IDIQ Single Award (see attachments for more details on the requirement) 

Full & Open Competition to Sources Qualified per the Manufacturer Qualification Requirements (MQR) attached.

All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency. If you are a foreign manufacturer, you must notify the Contracting Officer as early as possible and be approved by the Foreign Disclosure Office prior to receiving the technical data package.
